_sobre: Direção visual e cenas simuladas para a Apoteose, inspiradas nos prompts reais do ChatGPT (docs/product/referencia-prompts-chatgpt-apoteose.md). Servem aos testes da direção de arte (docs/product/direcao-de-arte-imagens.md); não são saída de IA.

visualDirection.finish: Realistic editorial photography with analogue grain and a tactile screen-print finish; visible pores and fabric texture.
visualDirection.atmosphere: Urban, intimate, sensual and irreverent Brazilian party behaviour.
visualDirection.graphics: Sparse organic cut-paper shapes in electric cyan laid over the photo like printed cut-outs.
visualDirection.avoid: parade costumes, feathers, masks, confetti, flags, generic palm trees, festival crowds

scenes.subject: adult Afro-Brazilian woman in her thirties, editorial fashion close-up, large translucent sculptural glasses
scenes.wardrobe: translucent amber glasses, small gold hoops
scenes.action: turns her gaze to the left of the frame
scenes.light: intense orange light on the face, deep indigo shadows, visible skin texture
scenes.graphics: cyan organic leaf strokes on the right edge and over a small area of the cheek; a few acid green dots top right

scenes.subject: three or four adult friends of different skin tones, softly out of focus, seen from inside a dark concrete passage
scenes.wardrobe: one bare orange-lit shoulder close to the camera
scenes.action: gather close as the party begins
scenes.setting: contemporary São Paulo rooftop at dusk, distant city, no recognisable landmark
scenes.light: cyan rim light on the architecture, cobalt and magenta in the background, deep indigo dominant
scenes.graphics: one large cyan shape partly cut at the top corner, a magenta organic form at the bottom

scenes.subject: two adult Brazilian dancers, a dark-skinned woman and a man in his thirties
scenes.wardrobe: sculptural orange satin top; dark casual tailoring
scenes.action: dance in a dark urban club, not looking at the camera
scenes.setting: dark urban club, no stage, no DJ booth
scenes.light: saturated orange and magenta long-exposure trails on fabric and gestures, sharp realistic faces
scenes.graphics: a few cyan organic elements at the top and outer edge

scenes.subject: adult Brazilian woman DJ with short curly hair
scenes.action: hands on the controller, anatomically natural
scenes.light: orange side light on the face, deep magenta shadows, a thin cyan rim, amber reflections on the gear
scenes.graphics: cyan organic shapes only at the outer edge, small acid green dots

scenes.subject: five adult Brazilian friends aged 28 to 42, different skin tones and genders
scenes.wardrobe: orange silk, a dark purple open-collar shirt, small cyan earrings
scenes.action: laugh and lean toward each other
scenes.expression: affinity, not posing for the camera
scenes.setting: intimate night party in São Paulo
scenes.light: warm direct orange flash with magenta shadows
scenes.graphics: an irregular cyan arc behind the group at the outer edge, a few green dots

scenes.subject: abstract identity background with no people
scenes.action: a single large cut-paper organic form overlaps a fluid orange and magenta shape
scenes.setting: very dark indigo paper with fine grain
scenes.graphics: one cyan cut-paper form bleeding off the outer edge, small cluster of acid green dots

scenes.subject: close detail of two adult hands, one in orange satin, one with a gold ring
scenes.graphics: a thin cyan line crossing the outer edge

scenes.subject: two adult friends of different genders walking on a São Paulo street at night
scenes.action: walk away from the party, one looks back
scenes.expression: complicity, wanting the night to go on
scenes.setting: empty downtown street, no legible signs
scenes.light: orange street light on faces, indigo night
scenes.graphics: a cyan organic stroke on the outer edge

scenes.subject: small group of adult guests of different skin tones leaving at first light
scenes.setting: concrete staircase of a rooftop, early dawn
scenes.light: first indigo-to-orange dawn light, magenta in the shadows
scenes.graphics: a cyan cut-paper form on the outer edge
